title: Most babies look when their name is called by nine months
summary: Most babies look when you call their name by nine months, the CDC says.
body: The CDC nine-month social milestones include looking when someone calls the baby's name. The response is a look, which uses hearing plus attention. The agency defines these milestones as things most children, 75 percent or more, do by the age, and it says the materials are not a screening tool. A child who does not yet do it is not diagnosed by this card.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports 'Looks when you call her name' by nine months for most children (75% or more), and the disclaimer against using the materials as a screening tool.
